post.summary: Read a stable source-balanced batch of published playable media
post.description: Read-only. Requires authentication, preserves filters, excludes up to 1000 recent displayed stable keys, and bypasses the catalogue cache. Cursor is bound to the seed, filters, exclusions, page size and eligible catalogue. Catalogue changes invalidate the cursor; restart the batch. Does not acquire, publish or write learning evidence.

Issue validated playback information with the approved transcript
get.description: Returns the current published version and every approved cue. The response contract is unchanged. With `include=text` each cue's `words` is null and the word-timing JSON is neither read nor transferred, which makes it the fast first phase for media detail pages; clients then request the full transcript (with word timings) to enable per-word highlighting.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Omit word-level timings (all `words` are null) to load the transcript text first.

post.summary: Suggest a private Spanish expression from a Chinese or mixed draft
post.description: Uses at most six completed, non-withdrawn messages from the authenticated user's conversation with this current published character. No draft, message, memory or learning evidence is saved. The client previews or reads the result and sends it only on explicit user action. A later assisted stream request declares assistance=translation; absence of this declaration is not proof of independent ability.

200.description: Transient expression and matching attemptId; private, no-store

409.description: Attempt key reused with a different draft

429.description: Pending attempt capacity or provider rate limit

post.summary: Answer a private learning question, suggest a reply, check grammar, or analyse sentence structure
post.description: Private, no-store learning assistance. Reads at most eight completed, non-withdrawn messages from the authenticated user's own conversation with this current published character; the client sends only the question or target sentence the learner chose to check. No message, assistant transcript, relationship memory or learning evidence is saved, nothing is auto-sent, and a suggestion enters the composer only on explicit user action. The provider call is recorded as opaque metadata only (provider, model version, latency, request id, estimated cost); questions, drafts, conversation context and model output are never logged or stored. The response is transient and must not be treated as ability evidence.

200.description: Transient structured learning answer; private, no-store

400.description: Invalid request or no sentence available to analyse

503.description: Conversation context, contact state or assistant provider unavailable

post.summary: Stream semantic reply bubbles with durable prefixes and one completed turn
post.description: Optional pendingMessages preserve earlier unanswered user turns (20 messages including latest). A supersedes visibility count may only trim an owned unfinished generation's stored prefix. Prefixes are saved before delta; final persistence precedes done. Completed retries replay without another provider call or memory extraction.

200.description: NDJSON meta, delta, done, or terminal error frames

409.description: Message text or assistance conflict, generation already running, or cancelled generation requires a new id

503.description: Conversation persistence, contact, or provider unavailable

get.description: Read-only and authenticated. Rechecks publication, rights, current source version, transcript approval and private article ownership. Returns original source segments, available media translations and eligible neighboring context without relying on lexical occurrence indexing. Defaults to source rotation. No learning evidence is written. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store. Query object contract: ../../schemas/v1/corpus-examples-query.schema.json. entryKind and entryId must be provided together.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional surface-text query. Omit to browse complete source examples.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: Consecutive ordered tokens, or all query tokens within the same source segment.

parameters.name: sourceKind
parameters.description: Exact source name filter retained for existing deep links.

parameters.name: entryKind
parameters.description: Legacy indexed entry restriction; requires entryId.

parameters.name: entryId
parameters.description: Legacy indexed entry restriction; requires entryKind.
